columns.name: plan_format
columns.reason: Format of the submitted plan set is fixed at submission, before adjudication.

columns.name: appeal_hearings_scheduled
columns.reason: Appeals are only scheduled after an adverse decision, so this postdates the target.

columns.name: lot_orientation
columns.reason: Static physical property of the parcel, known before any application.

columns.name: zoning_district
columns.reason: Standing municipal zoning designation for the parcel, fixed at submission.

columns.name: streetlight_zone
columns.reason: Static municipal service geography attached to the address.

columns.name: leaf_collection_zone
columns.reason: Static municipal service zone, unrelated to and prior to the permit review.

columns.name: site_access_code
columns.reason: Site access characteristic recorded with the parcel/application at intake.

columns.name: grading_permit_class
columns.reason: Scope-based classification assigned when the application is filed and categorized.

columns.name: reviewer_egress_deficiency
columns.reason: Reviewer finding produced during plan review, i.e. part of the adjudication itself.

columns.name: corner_lot_flag
columns.reason: Static parcel geometry attribute from the cadastre.

columns.name: septic_class
columns.reason: Existing site sanitation classification, known before the decision.

columns.name: applicant_type
columns.reason: Recorded on the application form at submission.

columns.name: days_to_final_disposition
columns.reason: Duration is only final once the disposition occurs, which is the target event.

columns.name: stormwater_tier
columns.reason: Regulatory tier derived from site and project scope, set at intake.

columns.name: fee_schedule_ver
columns.reason: Version of the fee schedule in force when the application is filed.

columns.name: parcel_shape_code
columns.reason: Static parcel geometry classification from property records.

columns.name: historic_overlay
columns.reason: Standing zoning overlay on the parcel, predates the application.

columns.name: fee_waiver_code
columns.reason: Waivers are normally requested and coded when fees are assessed at intake.

columns.name: recycling_route
columns.reason: Static municipal collection route assigned to the address.

columns.name: council_district
columns.reason: Static political geography of the parcel.

columns.name: frontage_class
columns.reason: Physical frontage characteristic of the lot, known before review.

columns.name: sidewalk_class
columns.reason: Existing streetscape attribute of the address, fixed at submission.

columns.name: curb_cut_code
columns.reason: Existing site access/driveway attribute recorded with the parcel.

columns.name: reviewer_setback_deficiency
columns.reason: Generated by the plan reviewer during adjudication, not available at filing.

columns.name: plan_sheet_count
columns.reason: Counted from the plan set as submitted at intake.

columns.name: parcel_area_m2
columns.reason: Static cadastral measurement of the parcel.

columns.name: ward_id
columns.reason: Static administrative geography of the parcel.

columns.name: post_decision_correspondence
columns.reason: Explicitly occurs after the decision, so it cannot exist at prediction time.

columns.name: notary_office
columns.reason: Notarization of application documents happens before or at submission.

columns.name: flood_zone_code
columns.reason: Published FEMA/municipal flood designation for the parcel.

columns.name: refuse_route
columns.reason: Static municipal collection route for the address.

columns.name: prior_approvals_5yr
columns.reason: Backward-looking history over the window ending at submission.

columns.name: utility_provider
columns.reason: Existing service territory assignment for the address.

columns.name: resubmission_count
columns.reason: Resubmissions accumulate during review, so the final count postdates the decision.

columns.name: assessor_roll_class
columns.reason: Standing property tax classification from the assessor's roll.

columns.name: easement_code
columns.reason: Recorded encumbrance on the parcel title, predates the application.

columns.name: submission_channel
columns.reason: Determined by how the application was filed, known at intake.

columns.name: school_district
columns.reason: Static administrative geography of the parcel.

columns.name: survey_vendor
columns.reason: The surveyor is identified on documents included in the submitted package.

columns.name: sewer_district
columns.reason: Static utility service district for the parcel.

columns.name: alley_access_flag
columns.reason: Static physical access attribute of the lot.

columns.name: e_filing_ver
columns.reason: Version of the filing system in use when the application was submitted.

columns.name: intake_clerk_id
columns.reason: Assigned at intake, which precedes review and decision.

columns.name: tree_ordinance_zone
columns.reason: Standing ordinance overlay for the parcel.

columns.name: designer_experience_yrs
columns.reason: Attribute of the design professional as of the submission date.

columns.name: snow_route_class
columns.reason: Static municipal snow-route designation for the street.
